# Deadline
> Breaking Hollywood entertainment, film, television, media, and awards news with industry-focused reporting and analysis.

Deadline is an entertainment trade publication covering studios, networks, streamers, talent, box office, television development, international markets, and awards season. Its coverage spans breaking news, exclusives, reviews, festival reporting, business analysis, and recurring franchise pages for major films and series.

## News
- [Latest News](https://deadline.com/v/latest/): Chronological feed of Deadline’s latest entertainment and media reporting.
- [Breaking News](https://deadline.com/v/breaking-news/): Fast-moving coverage of major Hollywood and media developments.
- [Film](https://deadline.com/v/film/): News and analysis on movies, studios, casting, and production.
- [TV](https://deadline.com/v/tv/): Television industry coverage including development, renewals, and casting.
- [Media](https://deadline.com/v/media/): Reporting on media companies, executives, strategy, and industry shifts.
- [Business](https://deadline.com/v/business/): Entertainment business news covering deals, finance, and corporate moves.
- [International](https://deadline.com/v/international/): Global entertainment industry coverage across markets and territories.

## Box Office
- [Box Office](https://deadline.com/v/box-office/): Domestic and international box office reporting, forecasts, and weekend analysis.
- [Weekend Box Office](https://deadline.com/tag/box-office/): Tagged coverage of box office results and theatrical performance.
- [Movie News](https://deadline.com/v/movie-news/): Film-specific reporting including release plans, production, and performance.
- [The Dish](https://deadline.com/v/the-dish/): Industry-focused commentary and reporting on film business developments.

## Television
- [TV News](https://deadline.com/v/tv-news/): Breaking television coverage across broadcast, cable, and streaming.
- [TV Reviews](https://deadline.com/v/tv-reviews/): Critical reviews of new and returning television series.
- [TV Casting](https://deadline.com/tag/casting/): Casting announcements and talent moves across television and film.
- [Pilot Buzz](https://deadline.com/v/pilot-buzz/): Coverage of pilot season, pickups, and development activity.
- [Premiere Dates](https://deadline.com/tag/premiere-dates/): Scheduling updates for upcoming series and returning shows.
- [Renewals](https://deadline.com/tag/renewed/): Reporting on series renewals across networks and streamers.

## Film
- [Film News](https://deadline.com/v/film-news/): Movie reporting on development, acquisitions, casting, and releases.
- [Film Reviews](https://deadline.com/v/film-reviews/): Reviews of theatrical releases, festival titles, and streaming films.
- [Casting](https://deadline.com/tag/casting/): Talent attachment and casting deal coverage across projects.
- [The Contenders](https://deadline.com/v/the-contenders/): Awards-season coverage focused on notable film and television contenders.
- [Movie Premieres](https://deadline.com/tag/premiere/): Coverage from premieres, red carpets, and launch events.

## Awards
- [AwardsLine](https://deadline.com/v/awardsline/): Deadline’s central hub for awards-season news, interviews, and analysis.
- [Awards Circuit](https://deadline.com/tag/awards-circuit/): Pete Hammond’s awards commentary and contender analysis.
- [Oscars](https://deadline.com/tag/oscars/): Academy Awards news, predictions, reactions, and campaign coverage.
- [Emmys](https://deadline.com/tag/emmys/): Emmy nominations, races, interviews, and television awards reporting.
- [Golden Globes](https://deadline.com/tag/golden-globes/): Coverage of Golden Globes nominations, winners, and campaigns.
- [Cannes](https://deadline.com/tag/cannes-film-festival/): Festival reporting, acquisitions, premieres, and awards from Cannes.
- [Sundance](https://deadline.com/tag/sundance-film-festival/): Coverage of Sundance premieres, deals, reviews, and festival news.

## Features
- [Features](https://deadline.com/v/features/): Long-form reporting, interviews, analysis, and special packages.
- [Breaking Big Story](https://deadline.com/v/breaking-big-story/): In-depth reporting on major entertainment industry developments.
- [Read the Screenplay](https://deadline.com/v/read-the-screenplay/): Awards-focused screenplay publication series for film contenders.
- [Read the Pilot](https://deadline.com/v/read-the-pilot/): Published pilot scripts and television awards-season materials.
- [Video](https://deadline.com/v/video/): Interviews, panels, clips, and event video coverage.
- [Photo Gallery](https://deadline.com/v/photo-gallery/): Image galleries from premieres, festivals, and industry events.

## Franchises & Recurring Coverage
- [Contenders Television](https://deadline.com/tag/contenders-television/): Event and editorial coverage of television awards contenders.
- [Contenders Film](https://deadline.com/tag/the-contenders/): Coverage tied to Deadline’s film awards events and contenders.
- [Most Valuable Blockbuster Tournament](https://deadline.com/tag/most-valuable-blockbuster-tournament/): Annual analysis of studio film profitability and performance.
- [Sound & Screen](https://deadline.com/tag/sound-screen/): Composer-focused awards coverage and music-for-screen conversations.
- [Disruptors](https://deadline.com/tag/disruptors/): Profiles and reporting on influential entertainment executives and creators.

## Reviews & Criticism
- [Reviews](https://deadline.com/v/reviews/): Aggregated film and television review coverage.
- [Film Reviews](https://deadline.com/v/film-reviews/): Critical assessments of movies across theatrical and streaming release.
- [TV Reviews](https://deadline.com/v/tv-reviews/): Reviews of scripted, unscripted, and limited television series.
- [The Film Verdict](https://deadline.com/tag/review/): Tagged review archive spanning movies, series, and festival titles.

## Events
- [Events](https://deadline.com/v/events/): Coverage of Deadline-hosted panels, summits, and industry gatherings.
- [Contenders Television](https://deadline.com/tag/contenders-television/): Event coverage spotlighting television awards hopefuls.
- [Contenders Film Los Angeles](https://deadline.com/tag/contenders-film/): Reporting from Deadline’s film awards events and panels.
- [Sound & Screen Film](https://deadline.com/tag/sound-screen-film/): Composer and score-focused event coverage for film contenders.
- [Sound & Screen Television](https://deadline.com/tag/sound-screen-television/): Television music and score event coverage.

## People & Industry
- [Executive Moves](https://deadline.com/tag/executive/): Coverage of executive appointments, exits, and leadership changes.
- [Agencies](https://deadline.com/tag/agency/): Reporting on agencies, representation deals, and talent business moves.
- [Studios](https://deadline.com/tag/studio/): News involving major film and television studios.
- [Streaming](https://deadline.com/tag/streaming/): Coverage of streaming platforms, strategy, and programming moves.
- [Networks](https://deadline.com/tag/network/): Reporting on broadcast and cable network business and programming.
